g.text: Derived permissions (permissions index) shipped by logical replication
tuples — the source of truth on the authz primary; every write is audited
the audit changefeed — what the worker consumes (stability lag, default 1 s)
engine code: the refresh worker on the primary; the subscriber-side helper; pgauthzd for live decisions
the derived tables — flat (subject, relation, object) rows plus the known subjects / objects (the wildcard contract) and a freshness row per store
logical replication — publication on the primary, subscription in each application database
